description: Compose one pre-computed Agent Data Core pack from the Layer 0 store: the pack's authored guidance plus, for every constituent, its pack-authored use-when line, verification state, and verbatim endpoints, with totals computed at compose time. An unknown pack id is answered free, before payment. Per-pack price (RULED): chain-reads $0.01 per call; web-evidence, company-diligence, market-intel and safety-preflight $0.05 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/packs/{pack_id}.

pack_id.description: The pack id to compose (see packs_catalog): chain-reads, web-evidence, company-diligence, market-intel or safety-preflight.

name: pack_get
